complete_written_derivation.bosonic_support: Swapping the complete B1 and B2 systems exchanges the two summands, so P_Bose Xi=Xi.
complete_written_derivation.Bell_contraction: (braPhi2_{A0,B10} tensor I)Xi = psi_AB1 tensor |1>_B20 tensor v_B2 /sqrt2. The second summand has auxiliary pair01 and contracts to zero.
complete_written_derivation.necessity: If Q2(W)>=0, the arbitrary psi expectation on the right is nonnegative, hence W>=0.
complete_written_derivation.sufficiency: If W>=0, then K(W) is a tensor product of positive operators and hence positive; its Bose compression is positive.
complete_written_derivation.normalization_check: The two Xi summands have orthogonal auxiliary labels, so ||Xi||^2=2||psi||^2||v||^2; normalization does not change any sign.
complete_written_derivation.scope: This is a universal analytic equivalence for the stated lifted PSD family, not a finite numerical check and not a P44 no-go.
